version.changelog: Add UTM attribution tags (utm_source=clawhub) to ClawLink branding links so visits from this skill page are tracked as a distinct traffic source.

llm.summary: This skill openly sets up a GitHub integration through ClawLink and tells the agent to confirm write or destructive actions before running them.

dimensions.detail: The skill uses ClawLink and GitHub APIs rather than broad local file access, and access is described as limited to the connected GitHub account and granted permissions.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The install flow adds the ClawLink plugin to allowed OpenClaw tools and restarts the gateway; this is disclosed and purpose-aligned, though the plugin reference is unpinned and no checksum is provided.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions emphasize live tool discovery, describing unfamiliar tools, previewing writes, and getting explicit user confirmation before create, update, delete, workflow, or deployment actions.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The OpenClaw tool allowlist change persists after setup, but it is visible in the documented install and troubleshooting steps and no hidden persistence or backdoor behavior appears in the artifact.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The GitHub repository, issue, pull request, workflow, and release capabilities match the stated purpose; write and destructive operations are high-impact but disclosed.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Before installing, verify you trust the ClawLink plugin and only grant the GitHub repository permissions you need. Review any preview carefully before approving write, delete, workflow, or deployment actions, and revoke the GitHub connection or remove the plugin if you stop using it.
llm.findings: [T08] expected: The unpinned ClawLink plugin install is a real supply-chain consideration, but the artifact does not ship executable code or hide the install; it is the disclosed mechanism for enabling the GitHub integration.
